note: Abilities that need their user's own voice (a roar, kiai, shout, chant, song, spoken command or Verbal component): a Silenced creature cannot use them (owner 2026-09-29, combat/speech.py). record id -> {name, why (the printed words), options (only these options need it)}. Owner-editable. First list 2026-09-29 from a read of every ability whose text mentions speech (Sound and Music abilities can be performed without a voice, so they are not listed).

TAL_AIR_BREATH_OF_NO_DISTANCE.name: Breath of No Distance
TAL_AIR_BREATH_OF_NO_DISTANCE.why: "You may send a spoken message of up to one hundred words to that creature." No non-vocal delivery is offered.

TAL_BERSERKER_RIFT_STRIKE.name: Rift Strike
TAL_BERSERKER_RIFT_STRIKE.why: "Roar and strike with enough force to tear open a temporary rift." No alternative delivery is given.

TAL_SAND_THE_MOUNTAIN_REMEMBERS_IT_IS_DU.name: The Mountain Remembers It Is Dust
TAL_SAND_THE_MOUNTAIN_REMEMBERS_IT_IS_DU.why: "You speak the first erosion scripture: the law that every shape is temporary." Explicit, no alternative given.

TAL_SOUND_SOUND_INITIATION.name: Sound Initiation
TAL_SOUND_SOUND_INITIATION.why: "you may create one harmless sound ..., throw your voice to a visible point, dampen one small noise, cause one unattended object to hum, or cause a small surface to vibrate" -- only the 'throw your vo
options: throw your voice to a visible point

WARLEADER_BASE_FIERCE_SHOUT.name: Fierce Shout
WARLEADER_BASE_FIERCE_SHOUT.why: Title "Fierce Shout"; body text gives no non-vocal alternative delivery (unlike Thunderclap Palm's disjunctive list). Base ability for the Warleader 'Shout' family.

tianxia.path.body_refining.feature.iron_.name: Iron Voice
tianxia.path.body_refining.feature.iron_.why: "Iron Voice is blocked by total silence ... or a feature explicitly suppressing cultivation pressure or bodily sound" -- a vocal/bodily-sound projection at a creature that can hear you.

tianxia.subpath.body.oni_blood.feature.d.name: Demon Roar
tianxia.subpath.body.oni_blood.feature.d.why: "The roar does not force movement, compel attacks..." -- explicitly a roar (body-origin sound), consistent with the Roar family (see Dragon's Roar).

tianxia.subpath.body.ryujin.feature.drag.name: Dragon's Roar
tianxia.subpath.body.ryujin.feature.drag.why: "The roar is a Sound- and body-origin effect. Silence ... can contest or prevent it" -- explicit roar/vocalization requirement.

tianxia.subpath.qi.kiai_master.feature.c.name: Commanding Voice (Imperial Command)
tianxia.subpath.qi.kiai_master.feature.c.why: Target: "One creature that can hear and understand you"; "Choose one command before the saving throw" -- an issued verbal command.

tianxia.subpath.qi.kiai_master.feature.h.name: Heaven's Roar
tianxia.subpath.qi.kiai_master.feature.h.why: Title "Heaven's Roar", 60-ft cone Thunder attack; same Kiai Master roar/shout-cone family as Dragon's Roar/Demon Roar, no alternative delivery given.

tianxia.subpath.qi.kiai_master.feature.k.name: Kiai
tianxia.subpath.qi.kiai_master.feature.k.why: "Kiai" is itself a canonical martial shout; Bonus Action targeting a creature that can hear you, Wisdom save to Frighten.

tianxia.subpath.qi.kiai_master.feature.s.name: Shattering Shout
tianxia.subpath.qi.kiai_master.feature.s.why: Title "Shattering Shout"; Kiai Master cone attack, same shout family as Heaven's Roar, no alternative delivery given.

tianxia.talent.imbuement.the_edict_that_.name: The Edict That Names the World Again
tianxia.talent.imbuement.the_edict_that_.why: "You speak an Edict that briefly renames one property of the battlefield." Explicit, unlike other (non-vocal) Edict talents.

tianxia.talent.stars.star_name_seal.name: Star Name Seal
tianxia.talent.stars.star_name_seal.why: "You speak the star-name assigned to its current position." Explicit, no alternative given.

tianxia.talent.warleader.call_attention.name: Call Attention
tianxia.talent.warleader.call_attention.why: "Use this Shout to draw hostile attention." Part of the Warleader Shout family, no non-vocal alternative given.

tianxia.talent.warleader.darklands_cry.name: Darklands Cry
tianxia.talent.warleader.darklands_cry.why: "Darklands Cry - Shout, Morale"; part of the Warleader Shout family, no non-vocal alternative given.

tianxia.talent.warleader.focusing_cry.name: Focusing Cry
tianxia.talent.warleader.focusing_cry.why: "Focusing Cry - Shout, Focus"; part of the Warleader Shout family, no non-vocal alternative given.

tianxia.talent.warleader.frightful_roar.name: Frightful Roar
tianxia.talent.warleader.frightful_roar.why: "Frightful Roar - Shout, Morale"; part of the Warleader Shout family (uses the Fierce Shout action), no non-vocal alternative given.

tianxia.talent.warleader.harangue.name: Harangue
tianxia.talent.warleader.harangue.why: "Harangue - Shout, Morale"; part of the Warleader Shout family, no non-vocal alternative given.

tianxia.talent.warleader.rallying_speech.name: Rallying Speech
tianxia.talent.warleader.rallying_speech.why: "Rallying Speech - Shout, Morale"; part of the Warleader Shout family, no non-vocal alternative given.

tianxia.talent.warleader.recall_spirit.name: Recall Spirit
tianxia.talent.warleader.recall_spirit.why: "Recall Spirit - Shout, Morale"; part of the Warleader Shout family ("Choose one creature within your Shout area"), no non-vocal alternative given.

tianxia.talent.warleader.rousing_claxon.name: Rousing Claxon
tianxia.talent.warleader.rousing_claxon.why: "Rousing Claxon - Shout, Morale"; part of the Warleader Shout family, no non-vocal alternative given.

tianxia.talent.warleader.thunder_banner_.name: Thunder Banner Cry
tianxia.talent.warleader.thunder_banner_.why: "Thunder Banner Cry - Shout"; part of the Warleader Shout family, no non-vocal alternative given.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.choir_of_the_un.name: Forced Confession
tianxia.tradition.spirit.choir_of_the_un.why: "Choose one question from the following list and speak it aloud." Explicit.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.sovereign_will..name: Commanding Voice
tianxia.tradition.spirit.sovereign_will..why: "Speak one brief command to one creature that can hear you or spiritually perceive your authority." Explicit.
